Medhātithi's Manubhāṣya, Adhyāya 1
transcribed, edited, formatted, and color-coded by Patrick Olivelle (CC BY 4.0)

manum ekāgram āsīnam abhigamya maharṣayaḥ |
pratipūjya yathānyāyam idaṃ vacanam abruvan ||
Salutation to the Supreme Brahman! His real character can be known only from the Vedānta texts. The word manum here denotes the Prajāpati of that name. || 1.1 ||
bhagavan sarvavarṇānāṃ yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ |
antaraprabhavāṇāṃ ca dharmān no vaktum arhasi ||
The address bhagavan is used towards one worthy of reverence. || 1.2 ||
